answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to a proof-of-burn wharf that routes coordination traffic. Every identity registration permanently burns cryptographic stake as a collateral ember. To scale influence, each additional identity requires burning stake that grows superlinearly under cost function C(k)=k^2. A cheap gossip whisper cannot broadcast without verifiable burned receipts, forcing attacker resource costs into steep exponential decay relative to honest network utility.
